prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Helpful changes: Reordering onboarding flow sequences (sign-in after adoption, story-first flow), targeted functional hints (photo upload, path helper, sign-in security), effective layouts (card carousel, single-click identity), specific desktop flows (summon, visibility & control), and quick control redesigns consistently won.
Harmful changes: Desktop docking setup flow, split personality layout redesign, spotlight path selector layout, account persistence hint, and specific copy changes (streamlined path copy, companion name certification copy) significantly hurt performance and led to early test stops.
No clear effect: Wait, progress, and loading indicators, background notifications, tutorial and showcase screens, incentives, and several copy and layout variations showed no clear effect.
Predictions too high: Large predicted gains (+8.5% to +15.0%) consistently overestimated actual impact, frequently yielding smaller gains, no clear effect, or early test cutoffs.
Predictions too low: Major winning tests—especially key desktop flows (visibility & control, summon flow), story-first sequence reordering, card carousel layout, and sign-in security hint—were significantly underestimated.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Placement Verification Screen: Add a new interactive verification screen after home intro where users click a button to test pet wave rendering on their screen. (why: 3 support emails noted pets failing to display on the desktop or the desktop application failing to open upon finishing.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Sign-In Prior to Adoption Certificate Reorder: Move sign-in immediately before adoption certificate creation so user identity is bound before official companion naming. (why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after sign-in, indicating late account binding creates data decoupling.)
2: [home, hint] Waiting Screen Desktop Overlay System Hint: Add a prominent system permission hint on the waiting screen explaining what to check if the pet window is hidden. (why: Home step conversion has high mean wait times (2336s) and 3 users reported desktop pet visibility issues.)
3: [choose_path, layout] Full Bleed Path Selection Layout: Switch the choose path screen to a full bleed hero layout clearly highlighting custom creation versus preset adoption. (why: Path decision has a long mean completion time of 514s, showing tail end user indecision on screen layout options.)
4: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Preparation Progress Bar: Display explicit progress status indicators and estimated wait time while desktop rendering initialises. (why: Home step dropoff (16.1%) and long mean durations (2336s) indicate user dropoff during render waiting.)
5: [finish, copy] Companion Quick Shortcut Hotkey Copy: Update the home intro text with explicit hotkey shortcuts for toggling, hiding, and talking to the desktop pet. (why: 3 support tickets expressed post-onboarding confusion regarding how to hide or interact with their pet.)
6: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Verification Badge: Display a prominent official pet registration badge component on the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption has the lowest step conversion rate (64.2%) and longest mean duration (1017s).)
7: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Pet Control Practice Screen: Add an interactive practice screen at onboarding end where users test dragging, hiding, and talking to their desktop pet. (why: 7 support messages were about post-onboarding confusion or desktop feature misbehavior.)

scores.note: New screens historically show negative impact (-0.4%) and carry high implementation cost.
Flow reordering supported by 8 support emails and strong historical results (+3.6%).
Targeted hints on home screen consistently win (+4.3%) and address long mean wait times.
Path selection layout tweaks show minimal historical impact (+0.7%) and lack direct support mail evidence.
Lessons indicate progress and wait indicators show no clear effect (+0.8%).
Low cost config change, but copy edits at finish step historically hurt conversion (-1.2%).
High potential impact on adoption step (lowest conversion), but incentives show no clear effect.
Strong support mail alignment, but practice/tutorial new screens carry high cost and no clear win history.
